new_tests.purpose: Exercise the parity builder with committed source artifacts and temporary negative fixtures.
Assert all L06 surfaces have separate fake and small-real metric coverage with normalized statuses.
Verify report checks distinguish measured, missing, skipped, and no-baseline values and reject rendered metric sources.
Validate committed wrapper-produced real evidence boundaries without running P14.
Run the L06 parity gate and schema validation as a CI-contract test.

new_cli_gates.reason: Audits committed wrapper-produced real evidence and source artifacts; it does not start new Valkey nodes.

new_artifact_checks: Require one surface record for cluster_smoke, management_ops, workload_smoke, observability_smoke, fault_sandbox, failover_primary_stop, stability_soak, and cleanup.
Require source_artifacts entries with path, sha256, artifact_type, schema_path, schema_valid, status, producer, and run_id where applicable.
Require fake coverage and real coverage to be recorded separately.
Require P07/P08 skipped data-path and observed-impact semantics to stay SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reasons.
Require P08 split_brain_duration_ms to stay MISSING with reason not_measured_by_primary_stop_gate.
Require report checks proving measured, missing, skipped, and no-baseline statuses are present and distinct.
Require command logs to contain no P14 execution or opt-in environment token.

expected_initial_failures.reason: The L06 parity script and schema do not exist before current-stage harness implementation.
The L06 focused tests do not exist before harness implementation.

acceptance_criteria: The L06 parity audit schema validates artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/small_real_parity_audit.json.
All eight required L06 surfaces have fake fixture coverage and real small-Valkey coverage recorded separately.

Real coverage is accepted only from wrapper-produced source artifacts with real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x, PASS status, expected node semantics, cluster state ok, cleanup PASS, and schema-valid probes.
P07 requires six nodes, sandbox-only safety, host_network_mutated false, global_firewall_mutated false, fault_state_cleared true, and explicit skipped data-path semantics.
P08 requires a six-node state artifact, post-fault live nodes at least five, promotion observed, failover latency measured, cleanup PASS, and explicit missing split-brain semantics.

Every real scenario contributes normalized metrics with source_artifact, source_sha256, source_pointer, scenario, node_count_scope, evidence_layer, evidence_class, value_status, and missing_semantics.
Rendered report files are never used as measured metric sources.
No L06 command runs P14, sets VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, or counts 1000 dry-run/planner artifacts as real coverage.
Previous harness, current harness, review, validation, and anti-regression checks all pass before commit and push.
